architecture: MiMoV2ForCausalLM (hybrid full/sliding-window GQA, MoE; text stack of the multimodal checkpoint)

sources.host_geometry: model-families/mimo25/include/sparkpipe/spark_mimo25_model.h, derived 2026-07-19 from the released config.json, modeling_mimo_v2.py and the safetensors shard headers (ranged fetch - exact dtypes and shapes, not inference)
sources.contract_note: transcribed from the family header so tools/generate_recipe.py has one authoritative JSON per served model; every value below cites that header, which remains the ground truth the C side compiles against
sources.precision_policy: linear weights FP8 E4M3 with F32 scale_inv per [128,128] block; embeddings, head, norms and sink biases BF16; router gate and bias F32; GEMM accumulation FP32

hybrid_attention.layer_kind_note: SPARK_MIMO25_MODEL_LAYER_KIND in the family header: 9 full-attention layers, not the 7 an early estimate assumed

cache.kv_element_source: SPARK_MIMO25_MODEL_BF16_ELEMENT_BYTES in the family header; KV is cached pre-scaled BF16 (value scale folded before the cache write)
